name: OSC VALIDATION — 3 addresses
description: Minimal map to confirm OSC is working end to end. Send these three addresses from TouchOSC or any OSC sender and watch huff respond. Once confirmed, load touchosc-mix.json.

mappings._section: TEST 1 — Fader: send /1/fader1 with value 0.0–1.0  →  FEEDBACK slider moves

mappings.note: TouchOSC Mix template Fader 1. Push up → image smears. Pull down → clears.

mappings._section: TEST 2 — Toggle: send /1/toggle1 with value 1.0  →  GLITCH toggles on/off

mappings.note: TouchOSC toggle button. 1.0 = on, 0.0 = off. All glitch tiles appear/disappear.

mappings._section: TEST 3 — Trigger: send /1/push1 with value 1.0  →  RESEED fires

mappings.note: Any value > 0.5 fires the reseed button. Glitch pattern randomises.
